option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific cardiac conduction abnormality (RBBB) and a cause of cardiac arrest (hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation), which are not directly related to the provided leaf of 'Acute massive pulmonary embolism with cardiac arrest (PEA)'.

The option describes a general category of cardiac electrical problems (malignant arrhythmia or conduction system abnormality), which is not directly related to the provided leaf of 'Acute massive pulmonary embolism with cardiac arrest (PEA)'.

The option describes a respiratory condition (acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure), which is not directly related to the provided leaf of 'Acute massive pulmonary embolism with cardiac arrest (PEA)'.
